name: exported-device-leakage

replacements.after: device: { syncOn: true }, settings, accounts: Object.fromEntries(accounts.sort

test: export includes every supported field and kept filter in exact deterministic file bytes
assertion: The entire exported text equals expected-file.json, which contains no Device data.

name: dropped-kept-filters
test: round trip retains a live filter even when its account has no chosen playlists
assertion: PL_ONLY_KEPT survives round trip for the account with no chosen playlists.

name: wrong-account-replacement-scope
test: import plans exact account replacements and keeps absent unrelated accounts
assertion: The replacement descriptor explicitly keeps absent accounts and lists exactly the two included accounts.

name: newer-format-acceptance
test: newer format with current-shaped data is still refused
assertion: A valid current-shaped file with format 2 yields DATA-55.newer-format, never an ImportPlan.

name: private-import-acceptance
test: private import refuses before parsing and file privacy claims cannot override context
assertion: A private-bound planner returns the private refusal for a valid file and for a file claiming normal privacy.
